title: The Thread (mài)
description: The primary motif: one continuous ink-blue line that IS the video's idea. It is rendered once at storyboard level and morphs between named paths at scene boundaries, so it never cuts.

do: Give it one meaning per video and say it in motif.meaning
Let it physically connect consecutive scenes
Under VO, sync the pulse blip to meta.pulse.bpm
dont: Use thread colour for anything else except the single thread-word in a caption
Break it with a hard cut
Add a second line in thread colour
